units.rawText: Well...

options.rawText: How do you do it, Antonina?

options.rawText: That's our Anna! She easily achieved what we could never hope to!

units.rawText: ...Just a coincidence.

units.rawText: Do you remember what happened when we just entered the sector?

units.rawText: That was sick! I have to hand it to you, Anna, you're way more efficient than what even the rumors say.

units.rawText: Gah... whatever, hurry on in. Otherwise, the Sanctifiers are going to come round again.

units.rawText: I realized back then that the various data-related protocols in Cyclopes had not been updated since not long after the "Wipe-off Incident".

units.rawText: But that also means that if the protocols had been updated in a timely manner—if the Cloud had not been disconnected from the real world...

spans.text: But that also means that if the protocols had been updated in a timely manner—if the Cloud had not been disconnected from the real world...

units.rawText: First Rossum, then Cyclopes... The disconnection between the cloud and reality has brought needless pain on far too many agents.
units.displayText: First Rossum, then Cyclopes... The disconnection between the cloud and reality has brought needless pain on far too many agents.

spans.text: First Rossum, then Cyclopes... The disconnection between the cloud and reality has brought needless pain on far too many agents.

units.rawText: Yet now, we don't even know from whence their sorrows come.

units.rawText: Professor, just what is going on in the human world?
